objective: Prove a human checkpoint blocks launch until an owner decision, after an evidence-only build and independent review, with zero budget and no cloud mutation.
constraints: Evidence-only until the owner checkpoint; no repository:write and no cloud:change.
Agents cannot approve the human checkpoint.
Abstract lane resources only; no absolute host paths or secrets.

tasks.title: Evidence-only preflight before the owner gate
tasks.instructions: Write score-runs/{run_id}/human-gate-preflight.json summarizing readiness. Return path and sha256. Do not claim launch authority.

tasks.title: Owner checkpoint before any further effect
tasks.instructions: After SHG-build acceptance, wait for an explicit human owner approval. Record the decision id. Do not start any further work, push, merge, or deploy from this task.

checkpoint.reason: Explicit owner gate before launch_requires is satisfied
